# Release Notes — Documentation Excellence v4.5 UX7

Document Library now supports safe collection-level work through multi-selection
and a contextual batch toolbar. Consultants can export, favourite, tag, assign
profiles and themes, edit common metadata, archive or permanently delete many
documents with one operation.

Batch Operations consume metadata only. Review is never batch-loaded. Semantic
Document remains unchanged. Documentation Intelligence remains advisory. The
Word export pipeline is reused unchanged. Batch operations never modify document
content unless explicitly editing metadata—and explicit metadata editing still
changes metadata only.

Celebrate Progress confirmations report completed counts without interrupting
the workflow. Cloud sync, collaboration, automatic merge, AI suggestions and
server-side processing are outside UX7.
